verdict.rationale: Pomelo's documented AI features are an assistant for questions about the Pomelo API and an MCP server that finds endpoints and generates code samples. These help developers with documentation; neither is shown to produce insights or suggestions from the customer's own operational data. The Dashboard monitoring feature is described with no AI-generated analysis, so the evidence offers only adjacent capabilities and no direct support for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
